frame_sampling: Collect a 3-second window at 25 FPS, or resample the available live detections to exactly 75 frames.
landmark_order: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker indices 0..20 in the official order; each point is x,y,z.
coordinate_source: Flutter Android native Hand Landmarker output before UI mirroring.

normalization.per_frame: For each detected hand, subtract landmark 0 wrist from all 21 points.
normalization.scale: Divide the centered hand by the Euclidean norm of landmark 9 (middle-finger MCP) relative to the wrist; fall back to the maximum centered landmark radius if needed.
normalization.missing_hand: Use 63 zero values for the missing hand and preserve the 75-frame sequence length.

handedness: Use native MediaPipe subject handedness to assign left/right slots. Do not infer slots from screen position. UI-only front-camera mirroring must not be applied to model coordinates.
split_warning: The source archive has no signer/session/source-recording IDs. Metrics are not signer-independent and cannot guarantee augmented-source separation beyond exact-content grouping.
